tr.td: slow: the expert GEMMs are small. Some experts may also get no tokens.
Grouped-GEMM time per MoE layer from the profiler, TFLOP/s per GPU (--log-throughput), and tokens per expert (--save-tokens-per-expert-interval, A.1).
slow: the two extra projections and the smaller expert GEMMs add time. blows up: Kimi K3 reports exploding activations in the routed branch.

For speed, profile the two latent projections and smaller expert GEMMs alongside the reduced all-to-all. For instability, one place to look is the up-projection output norm (fc2_latent_proj) from activation dumps (A.1); Kimi K3 reports routed-branch activation growth.
slow at inference, when it adds compute: Mellum2 found inference slower.
Shared output after its gate against routed output after combine and any latent up-projection, from the sparse forward hook in A.1.
slow: each expert size runs its own kernels, and GroveMoE reports about 30% slower inference than Qwen3-30B-A3B.
Per layer, mean and spread of selected FFN count or summed expert width against the target compute budget. Log token counts per expert alongside compute per EP rank and step time.
The max-to-median ratio of expert output norms per layer, Step 3.5 Flash's signal, from the activation dumps (A.1).
